card.name: Linking words before risk lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, and, reflecting) in set label phrases just before a list of risks or organ problems. Also the start of a drug name split into pieces, such as p in piroxicam.

modes.label: Linking word before risks
modes.description: The word 'the' or 'and' right before a list of harms or decreased organ function.
modes.example: reflecting<< the>> greater frequency of decreased hepatic, renal

modes.label: And closing a harm list
modes.description: The word 'and' before the last item in a list of serious outcomes.
modes.example: respiratory depression, coma,<< and>> death. Because of these risks, reserve

modes.label: Start of a split drug name
modes.description: The first piece of a drug name inside a list of drugs.

card.writes: It seems to push against the word 'two' and toward other continuations, so no clear output effect on risk wording.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in label sentences that lead into lists of risks or drug names.
